## API Docs
- VNNOX > Player > Player Management [Add Player](https://developer-en.vnnox.com/api-446386210.md):  1. This interface allows adding players to the cloud. After addition, the devices will be added to the pending activation list and automatically moved to the player list of the corresponding account once they are connected to the network.
- VNNOX > Player > Player Management [Obtain player list](https://developer-en.vnnox.com/api-180498654.md):

- VNNOX > Solutions [Common Solutions](https://developer-en.vnnox.com/api-180502121.md): :::tip
- VNNOX > Solutions [Offline Export](https://developer-en.vnnox.com/api-277397809.md): 1.Through this interface, you can export Nova playback protocol for offline programs
- VNNOX > Solutions [Over-specification Detection Switching](https://developer-en.vnnox.com/api-277399402.md): Use this API to control the player to enable or disable over-specification detection
- VNNOX > Solutions [Program Over-specification Detection](https://developer-en.vnnox.com/api-277411236.md): 1.This interface is used to check whether the program sent to the required devices will be any over-specification
